rows_of: synthetic, from the seed: distinct registrable domains of 2026-10-26 under a weighted list of suffixes; 40% day-precision rows of a day source (bit 8) at the start of the day, 60% second-precision rows of a second source (bit 1) at a random second; no row suspect or provisional
read_of: readFeed of packages/feed with its defaults (scanBlocks 8, block budget 2000) over the whole day, every read of a part, of the idx and of the tidx counted; read_ms is Node wall time in this process, not workerd CPU time
